items.q: And of course old Claudell and them dressed, so I had to outdress them, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah? Well, I don't know, I hope they don't think I'm boasting, but I paid a lot of money for my clothes. And I would wear the smartest clothes. And of course old Claudell and them dressed, so I had to outdress them, you know.
